motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals: rows, panels, popovers, view changes.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Departures: removed rows, the outgoing view.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Physical parts only: switch pill, toggle knob, button press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--solid, #111114); color: var(--on-solid, #f6f6f8); font: 600 13px/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(17 17 20 / .14), 0 10px 22px -10px rgb(17 17 20 / .55); transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.22, 0.6, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.965); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111114; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Preset Switch
components.description: Two presets with a sliding solid pill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(17 17 20 / .045); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(17 17 20 / .075); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 13px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; background: none; color: rgb(17 17 20 / .64); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-item b { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 640; } .ds-seg-item span { font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-seg-item.ds-on { background: #111114; color: #f6f6f8; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: #111114; } .ds-seg-item.ds-on:hover { color: #f6f6f8; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Outline marker such as Variable fps.
components.css: .ds-tag { padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 99px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(17 17 20 / .14); color: #111114; font: 620 10.5px/1.6 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Monochrome glass over a static wash. Colour belongs to the footage; the app draws only ink, white and the greys between. Every screen says what will happen before it happens.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome with a single solid per region
Real thumbnails that take colour on hover
Rich motion, gated only by the app's own switch

rules.name: The Footage Rule
rules.body: The only hue on screen is the footage.

rules.name: The One Solid Rule
rules.body: A region carries at most one solid element at rest.

dos: Show the output before the run
